column_contract.interpretation: Explicit diagnostic interpolant, not native/equilibrium column. Native mass-definition basis; top anchor interpolated, no fitted scale. Zero mass closure is construction, not validation.

local_binding.provider_scope: Explicit experimental opt-in only; legacy native-only loader unchanged

wide_spectrum.caveats: 41 source-matched FeI lines, Explicit neutral-H/He widths plus NONE/supplied/Cowley Stark prescription. H2 omitted to retain atomic EOS/continuum/O collision baseline; no HFS/isotope/molecular/other-species opacity; Teff/logg use interpolated source fields with new local densities and LTE populations, not a fresh atmosphere-equilibrium solution. Kurucz LTE reservoir is separate from limited native Fe atom, ratio reported. Same transfer equation, no spectrum multiplication or opacity scale; Population mode explicitly recorded, optional bounded O SE; no Fe abundance measurement or opacity/continuum adoption.

policy: solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: kpno_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'line_selection', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. No telluric_corrected declaration is made.
caveats: Fixed diagnostic partitions are not isolated oxygen EWs or blend identifications. No errors/covariance or optimization. Local controls never replace immutable baseline. Model-guided anchors remain incomplete-opacity diagnostics.
